body.statement: The coordinate projection of a semialgebraic set defined over the real algebraic numbers is semialgebraic over the real algebraic numbers.  Every finite family of semialgebraic subsets of \(\mathbb R^d\) admits a finite compatible smooth semialgebraic stratification.  Every semialgebraic set has finitely many connected components, and each connected component can be joined by a semialgebraic path that is piecewise continuously differentiable.

source.locator: Theorem 2.2.1, Theorem 2.4.5, Proposition 2.5.13, and Chapter 9, Section 9.1

attestation.note: The cited locations supply semialgebraic projection, finite connected-component and path facts, and compatible smooth stratification.
